objective._comment: Pre-registered strategy-label objective. Frozen 2026-10-30 before any benchmark run. Do not tune on test results; report sensitivity instead.
objective.quality_metric: exact-file recall vs deleted ground truth (SHA-256)
objective.model_selection: highest validation balanced accuracy; ties -> smaller depth, then larger min_samples_leaf; final model refit on train+val
objective.primary_comparison: per-test-image median end-to-end time and recall, CART vs each baseline (paired, Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided)
objective.acceptable_quality: per-image recall within 0.05 of the best fixed strategy on that image

cache_policy: no cache dropping (unprivileged-safe); run order randomised per image block; first run of each block is not discarded but repeats are summarised by median
